title: Decisions, Decisions
equipment: 5 balls per team; proposed goals, cones, pinnies.
setup: Two fields back-to-back: midfield section 10–15 yards long, final section 5–8 yards, width 15–20 yards (source). Adjust to site and children.
instructions: Each team starts five balls at halfway.
Two or three attackers face one defender.
Goal, ball out or keeper control ends a ball.
When either team finishes its fifth ball, stop and compare goals.
support: Proposed option: Remove the race element initially so children can understand choices.
challenge: Proposed option: Allow a defender counterattack (source progression).
observe: Does restart speed leave time to decide?
Does ball carrier notice defender and teammate?
